usage: deskops graph neighbors [-h] [--root ROOT] [--graph GRAPH] id

positional arguments:
  id             Graph node id to inspect, formatted as type:id (e.g.
                 atom:atom-name, task:task-name, issue:issue-name).

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    Target repository root.
  --graph GRAPH  Graph snapshot path; defaults to the root runtime snapshot.
